functions.name: payment_limit
functions.label: Per operation
functions.description: Limit the gross amount of one operation.

result.description: Remaining gross-amount headroom after the operation.

functions.name: lifetime_spending_limit
functions.label: Lifetime spending
functions.description: Limit cumulative irreversible expenses. Unpriced expenses return an error.

result.description: Remaining lifetime expense headroom after the operation.

functions.name: daily_spending_limit
functions.label: Daily spending
functions.description: Limit irreversible expenses on the request’s UTC day. Unpriced expenses return an error.

result.description: Remaining expense headroom on that UTC day.

functions.name: daily_volume_limit
functions.label: Daily volume
functions.description: Limit gross amounts plus attributable gas on the request’s UTC day. Unpriced expenses return an error.

result.description: Remaining gross-volume headroom on that UTC day.

functions.name: call_limit
functions.label: Operation count
functions.description: Limit successful operations, including earlier operations when this check was absent. A zero limit returns an error.

result.description: Successful operations remaining after this operation.

functions.name: destinations
functions.label: Destinations
functions.description: Require an exact permitted destination. An empty list returns an error.

functions.name: tokens
functions.label: Assets
functions.description: Require the underlying asset and, for swaps, the other token. An empty list returns an error.

functions.name: expires_at
functions.label: Expiry
functions.description: Require unexpired parameters and request. The parameter is an exclusive Unix timestamp in seconds. The request must expire no later than the parameters.

result.description: Seconds remaining before the parameters expire.

functions.name: operations
functions.label: Operations
functions.description: Require a permitted operation. A wildcard permits every representable operation. An empty list returns an error.
